title: Adapting Classic Scheduling Heuristics for Online Execution under Uncertainty
problem: Task scheduling on heterogeneous distributed systems with incomplete future knowledge
motivation: Real-world systems require online scheduling decisions without full task graph knowledge; classical offline schedulers (HEFT, CPoP) assume complete information unavailable at runtime
method: Modular parametric online scheduler adapting classical list-scheduling heuristics with dynamic decision-making based on evolving execution state
key_novelty: Extends HEFT/CPoP scheduling strategies to online setting with adaptive behavior; achieves near-offline performance (3-5% overhead vs 10% for naive baseline)
contributions: Online scheduling framework bridging classical offline and online approaches
Dynamic scheduling variants for different estimation methods and CCR settings
Comprehensive evaluation on scientific workflow benchmarks
limitations: Limited full future knowledge; evaluation scope on scientific workflows
